Ever notice how people texting at night have that eerie blue glow?

Or wake up ready to write down the Next Great Idea, and get blinded by your computer screen?

During the day, computer screens look good—they're designed to look like the sun. But, at 9PM, 10PM, or 3AM, you probably shouldn't be looking at the sun.

f.lux fixes this: it makes the color of your computer's display adapt to the time of day, warm at night and like sunlight during the day.

What is jetting and why is this important?

The best way I can explain this is if we understand the basics of how an engine and carb work. The carb mixes fuel with air before going into the engine. You will get better performance by finding the right ratio between air and fuel. Since air is vital to this equation you need to be aware of changes in air density that will require you to change the jets. If you tune your engine at sea level expect to make changes when riding up in the mountains. Likewise, if the temperature changes then it will also affect how your engine runs.

Practical Use:

A 2-stroke china girl kit typically has a .7mm jet. Switching this out for a .66mm jet will reduce the amount of fuel and cause the engine to run lean. You will have more air, less fuel, and get an increase in performance. The downside is that the engine will run hotter since there is less fuel/oil mixture to keep it lubricated. Running lean will wear out the engine faster than running rich.

For me this is one of the cheapest and simplest "mods" you can do to improve your performance.
